output.summary: The zero-deviation record is almost certainly a reporting artifact. A bonus penalty per deviation began in February, and reports fell from about 14 a month to zero. Meanwhile customer complaints, final-inspection rejections and replacement-material purchases all rose, and survey trust fell on every line. Line 3's 118% attainment is explained by unrecorded borrowed technicians, since output per technician-hour is flat, so it is not a transferable model. The hotline report alleges undocumented rework, and the closure was weak. Recommended: suspend the penalty with amnesty and non-retaliation, and run an independent investigation. Do not roll out Line 3, discipline anyone yet, or unmask the reporter. Who directs the lending remains unknown.
